notes.subject: lasabati kɛ ni Eloa ye
notes.rationale: וכח: 'plead for a man with God' (KJV, third party arbiter) vs 'a man pleading with God' (BSB, man as party); YLT reads it as statement, not wish

notes.subject: tɔgɔma
notes.rationale: רע literally 'associate/companion', rendered with Bambara companion-word

notes.subject: kena
notes.rationale: Hebrew has no optative verb; wish-context supplied (as in existing renderings 'Oh that...')

translation: Mɔgɔ kena lasabati kɛ ni Eloa ye, hadamaden fana ka lasabati kɛ ni a tɔgɔma ye!
